field.label: Upstream group
field.help: Which clients use this resolver. "default" applies to every client; otherwise a client name (wildcards * and [0-9] ranges supported), an IP address, or a CIDR subnet. Blocky matches each query's client against the upstream groups and falls back to "default". This is separate from the list groups under Clients.

field.label: Resolver
field.help: Upstream DNS resolver in blocky format [net:]host[:port][/path][#commonname]. "net" may be omitted (defaults to tcp+udp) or set to tcp+udp, tcp, udp, tcp-tls (DoT), https (DoH) or quic (DoQ). "host" may be an IPv4 address, an IPv6 address or a hostname; bracket an IPv6 address when a port follows. If the port is omitted the protocol default is used (53 for tcp/udp, 853 for tcp-tls/quic, 443 for https). "path" applies to DoH only, where it is the query endpoint; the other protocols ignore it. Optionally append #commonname to pin the server certificate. Examples: 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8:53, 2606:4700:4700::1111, tcp-tls:[2606:4700:4700::1111]:853, tcp-tls:fdns1.dismail.de:853, https://dns.google/dns-query, quic:dns.adguard.com. A DNS Stamp (sdns://...) is also accepted and can encode all of the above, including certificate hashes for automatic pinning - build one at dnscrypt.info/stamps.
